seo.title: Isomero — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Sanga ibitabo, izimbarago n'ibikoresho by'uburezi mu Isomero ry'Abaturage rya Isôoko i Masoro, mu Rwanda.

hero.title: Isomero Ryacu
hero.subtitle: Ibitabo, izimbarago n'ibikoresho by'uburezi birekuwe ku baturage ba Masoro

page.title: Reba Ibitabo
page.subtitle: Shakira igitabo kikurikiraho — ibitabo by'ubuvanganzo, iby'ishuri, inkuru z'abana n'ibindi

visit.title: Sura Isomero
visit.text: Ngwino usome, wige cyangwa uguze igitabo mu Kigo cy'Abaturage cya Isôoko. Isomero ryacu ni ubushake ku baturage bose ba Masoro.
visit.location: Kigo cy'Abaturage cya Masoro, Umurenge wa Masoro, Akarere ka Rulindo

reader.noContent: Ibikubiye muri iki gitabo birimo bitegurwa. Garuka vuba.

novel.ikirehe: Igitabo cy'ikinyarwanda kizwi ku isi, kivuga Kamana agarutse ku cyaro cye akamenya ko kongera kubaka umuryango gutangirana no kugirana ukuri no kubaho hamwe.
novel.umukunzi: Inkuru ihuza umutima ivuga Aurore, umukunzi w'urubyiruko i Kigali wamenye ko kumva abandi ari intambwe ya mbere yo gukiza umuryango watandukanijwe.
novel.umundi: Icyo gusobanura ukuri kwa nyina-ishobora kugeza ku isi — ibi bibuka umuryango n'igihugu mu buryo bukomeye.
novel.baredfoot: Scholastique Mukasonga asobanura nyina we, umugore utambagira ku birenge, wakomeje umuryango we mu mahoro n'urukundo.
novel.ourLady: Mu ishuri ry'abakobwa ry'i Hejuru ya Mubarika, uru ni urugendo rw'ubunywani, amacakubiri n'uburinganire hagati y'abantu batandukanye.
novel.murambi: Igitabo cyubaka ku buhamya bw'abazigama, kibaza ku kibazo cy'umusaraba, kwibuka, n'ubutabera nyuma ya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.
novel.antelope: Igikorwa cy'umwemerere Jean Hatzfeld, ku buhamya bw'abazigama bavuga uko bapfuye, uko bahindutse, n'urugendo rurerure rwo kugaruka mu buzima.
novel.thingsFallApart: Igitabo cya Chinua Achebe cy'isi yose — inkuru ya Okonkwo n'uko isi ye yapfuye buhoro buhoro igihe izindi ngengabihe zageraga.
novel.weepNotChild: Igitabo cya Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o gikomeza ku mutima, cy'umuhungu mu Kenya y'ngomanzi waroze amashuri ubwo umuryango we waremereraga mu ntambara y'ubwigenge.
novel.riverBetween: Igitabo cy'umuyobozi mukuru warikiwe, agerageza guhuza abantu babiri batandukanijwe n'umugezi, na gakondo n'impinduka mu Kenya y'ngomanzi.
novel.purpleHibiscus: Kambili, umukobwa w'i myaka cumi n'itanu, amenya ubutwari n'ijwi rye ubwo yimukiye hagati y'inzu ya se ikaze n'inzu ya nyirasenge aho umutima uhari.
novel.halfYellowSun: Igitekerezo kinini cy'urukundo n'intambara mu gihe cy'intambara ya Biafra, kirebera kuri bakwe bakoporora n'urugo rwabo.
novel.oldManSea: Inkuru ihuza ibihe byose ya Hemingway ku muvuzi mushaje warwanije fi nini yonyine mu nyanja — inkuru y'icyubahiro no kwihangana.
novel.animalFarm: Igitabo cya Orwell gifite isomo rifatika kuri abantu — abazima bo ku murima barive ku kintu kandi bagira nabi kandi bagira bibona.
novel.alchemist: Umworozi w'intama ukurikira inzozi ze yambukiranya ubutayu ashaka ubutunzi, asanga urugendo ubwaryo ari rwo mutekano nyawo.
novel.littleWomen: Igitabo cyakarishye cy'abakobwa bane ba March — Meg, Jo, Beth na Amy — bakuriye, bakunda, kandi bafashanya mu nziza n'ingorane.
novel.tomSawyer: Inkuru za Mark Twain z'umusore urangwaho urwenya, warereye ku ruzi rwa Mississippi n'ibibazo yahuraga na byo buri gihe.
novel.treasureIsland: Igitekerezo cy'ubuyobozi bwa pirate — Jim Hawkins muto, ikarita y'ubutunzi n'umunyabyaha Long John Silver.
novel.lifeLaidBare: Ihuriro ry'ubuhamya bugororotse buvuye mu karere k'ibiyaga mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda — inyandiko yo kwibuka no guhuza.
novel.chosen: Abahungu babiri bo mu miryango itandukanye ya Kiyahudi babaye inshuti mu 1940 mu mujyi wa Brooklyn — igitabo cy'abase, abana n'ikiruhuko.

education.ikinyarwanda: Uburyo bwuzuye bwo kwiga ikinyarwanda — ikibonezamvugo n'inkuru z'ibinyabuzima, byu akabato kagaragara.
education.historyRwanda: Ubushakashatsi burambuye ku mateka y'u Rwanda kuva kera kugeza magingo aya.
education.basicHealth: Igitabo gifatiye ku buzima bwiza — ubuvuzi bw'ibanze, isuku n'ubuzima bw'abaturage.
education.englishGrammar: Igitabo cy'ikibonezamvugo cy'icyongereza gisobanutse neza, gifite ingero n'umutoza.
education.mathematics: Imibare y'ishuri ribanza yorohereza, ifite ingero zivuye mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
education.biology: Igitabo cy'ubumenyi bw'ibinyabuzima cyoroheye kwiga — umubiri w'umuntu, ibimera n'ibidukikije.
education.physics: Ibintu byigisha imbaraga, urumuri n'ingufu, bisobanuwe n'ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu rugo.
education.chemistry: Atomu, ibice n'imbaraga bisobanuwe neza, bireba iyubahirize umutekano.
education.geography: Ubutaka, abaturage n'ikirere cy'u Rwanda n'akarere, bisobanuwe n'amakarita.
education.civics: Intangiriro y'uburenganzira n'inshingano z'abaturage, n'inzego z'u Republica y'u Rwanda.
education.frRwDictionary: Ikoranabuhanga ry'igifaransa–ikinyarwanda rishobora kwizerwa, ku banyeshuri, abahinduzi n'abantu bose.
education.historyAfrica: Intangiriro ku nshingano z'ibihugu by'Afurika — aho uyu mugabane w'Africa ukomoka n'uburyo uye.
education.kiswahili: Igitabo cyo kwiga ikiswahili ku bibanze — imvugo ya buri munsi n'inkuru z'ibintu bitandukanye.
education.writing: Ubuyobozi bunguke bwo kwandika neza — ku banyeshuri, abakozi n'abaturage.

children.villageDog: Buna, imbwa y'umudugudu izi amayira yose, yegereranya ko n'imbwa ishobora kuba mercury w'umuntu.
children.bigBird: Inyoni ifite amababa manini cyane, amenya ko ibyo imutandukanya n'andi ari byo bikinze barumwe.
children.goodChild: Amina yerekana ko ibikorwa bito by'ubugiraneza bya buri munsi ari byo bigira umuntu mwiza.
children.caterpillar: Inkende yananiwe kurya ikarya ikarya, gusa kugeza igihe ibintu byiza byabaye — inkuru y'urukundo ya buri mwana yo gukura no guhinduka.
children.lionMouse: Igitekerezo kiza cy'imbeba nto yazigamye ko n'umuntu muto ashobora gufasha cyane.
children.folktales: Inkuru z'abakuru zivugwa munsi y'igiti — inkuru z'u Rwanda z'ubwenge ku mwana wese.
children.alphabet: Kuva A kugeza Z, wasanganira umuntu wese urugero muri iki gitabo cy'inyuguti.
children.numbers: Wiga kubara, kongeramo no kugabana ku buryo bukwiye mu mudugudu wawe.
children.aesop: Inkuru z'igihe cya kera za Aesop zisobanuwe mu buryo bworoshye.
children.gorilla: Mundo, imfizi y'ingagi, irinda umuryango we mu ishyamba ry'igihumyi — inkuru y'urukundo n'ubuzima.
children.rainbowFish: Ifi nziza yamenye ko kugabana ibimenyetso byayo bitanga ibyishimo byinshi kuruta kubyigumiraho.
children.givingTree: Inkuru y'igiti n'umuhungu, yerekana ko urukundo rw'ukuri rutanga utabara.
children.wildSwans: Umukobwa ukomeye azudira imibyero y'ubuheza kugira ngo abohere mu nzoga indwi.
children.littleRedHen: Inkoko itukura ihinga, isarura kandi ikabaka yonyine — ijyera yamenye uwo bikwiye kugabana umugati.

other.communityLeadership: Ubuyobozi bw'abaturage mu Rwanda — ibikoresho, imiyoboro n'ubutwari bw'umutima.
other.sportsHealth: Impamvu siporo ibungabunga ubuzima bw'umubiri n'ubwenge, hamwe n'uwozima wa buri munsi.
other.inspiringStories: Abanyarwanda babayeyo bahuye n'ingorane, bitangira ubutwari n'ubwiyonge.
other.firstAid: Igitabo cy'ubuvuzi bw'ibanze: uko wasubiza amaso, ukuboko k'ingenzi, ugakiza ubuzima bw'umuntu.
other.farming: Ubuhinzi bakaheza ku buryo bujyanye n'u Rwanda — ubutaka, imbuto, amazi n'ubworozi.
other.business: Uburyo bwo guhindura igitekerezo giza mu bihumbi byo gukora umurimo muto — cyandikiwe urubyiruko rw'inkundabuzima.
other.nutrition: Isahane yuzuye kuri buri mafaranga: uko wasoma neza ukarinda ubuzima bw'umuryango wose.
other.environment: Impamvu ikirere gihinduka n'ibyo buri muturage yakora — gutera ibiti, kutabomba amazi, kwica imyanda.
other.soccer: Igitabo cy'umwarimu cy'abakinnyi batoya — uburyo, imikino, ubuzima n'ihungu.
other.rwandaHeroes: Ubuzima n'indangagaciro z'intwari z'u Rwanda — abantu basanzwe bahisemo gukora icyubahiro cya mbere.
other.savings: Uko utangura ukayobora itsinda ry'ubwizigame bw'umuryango — inzira ya mbere yo kubona ubwigenge bw'umari.
other.parenting: Gufasha ababyeyi kuva ku mwana w'ikusanyo kugeza mu kigero cy'urubyiruko, n'inama zifatiye ku mutima.
other.peacebuilding: Amahoro nk'igitondo cya buri munsi — ikiganiro, ubutabera n'ubwiyunge mu muryango w'u Rwanda.
other.umuganda: Umunsi wa gakondo w'akazi gakorwa n'abaturage — ubwumvikane no kwitanga k'umuntu umwe.
